description: This file defines database entities, data classes, and interfaces related to app metadata, localized files, and app representations in an Android application, using Room ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: MinimalApp
classes.description: Interface defining minimal app properties and a method to get app icon based on locale.

classes.name: AppMetadata
classes.description: Data class representing detailed app metadata, mapped to a database table with foreign key constraints.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Data class representing an app with metadata and localized resources, implementing MinimalApp.

classes.name: AppOverviewItem
classes.description: Lightweight app overview data class for listing apps with minimal details and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: AppListItem
classes.description: Lightweight app list item with installed version info and anti-feature filtering.

classes.name: UpdatableApp
classes.description: Represents an app with an available update, including version and icon info.

classes.name: IFile
classes.description: Interface for file entities with common properties.

classes.name: LocalizedFile
classes.description: Entity representing localized files linked to app metadata.

classes.name: LocalizedIcon
classes.description: Database view entity for icon files.

classes.name: LocalizedFileList
classes.description: Entity for lists of localized files.

methods.name: MetadataV2.toAppMetadata
methods.description: Converts MetadataV2 to AppMetadata, considering locale and compatibility.

methods.name: LocalizedTextV2.zero
methods.description: Modifies LocalizedTextV2 to add zero-width spaces for CJK languages.

methods.name: LocalizedFileV2.toLocalizedFile
methods.description: Converts LocalizedFileV2 map to list of LocalizedFile entities.

methods.name: List<IFile>.toLocalizedFileV2
methods.description: Converts list of IFile to LocalizedFileV2 map.
